verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a task diff view with a navigable changed-files tree. Draft PR creation is triggered by the user from the GitHub tab or diff view, so a developer can review the diff before a PR exists. There is no documented explicit approve/reject gate that blocks PR creation; the review-before-PR flow is only implied by PR creation being user-initiated. Missing for 10: an explicit documented approval step gating PR creation, inline diff commenting/approval docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request

citations.quote: Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
Move through the PR changes tree with J/K, N/P, G shortcuts, and Enter.
Task diffs now show clean repository names instead of encoded workspace paths.
One place for comments and review
